Azure Striker Gunvolt - Striker Pack.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt: Striker Pack
Azure Striker Gunvolt - Striker Pack.summary:
The game contains both Azure Striker Gunvolt and Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 packaged together with all the first games DLC and a new song.

The Switch version runs at 60 fps, has a new UI, has all previous dlc for both games from the 3DS, has a new theme song, and game play improvements like re-balancing difficulty and changing the Kudos system from the first game to the one used in the second.

Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell 3D.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell 3D
Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell 3D.summary: As Sam Fisher, Third Echelon's most skilled Splinter Cell operative, you are assigned to execute a hazardous series of operations to investigate and eliminate a new source of information attacks originating in North Korea. At your disposal is a lethal array of tactics ranging from Combat Knife techniques to experimental prototype weapons skills and more-radical hand-to-hand techniques such as the Inverted Chokehold. Experience the intensity of acting as a lone operative fighting tomorrow's threats in the field and of cooperating online with a partner to accomplish crucial missions.
